description: Received a fake NZ Post email saying my parcel was on hold. The link went to a page asking for credit card details. The domain had nothing to do with NZ Post.
Got a text message claiming I had won a $500 New World voucher. The link asked me to fill in my personal information and credit card to pay a small delivery fee.
An email claiming to be from IRD said I was owed a tax refund and needed to verify my bank account. The domain was not the real IRD website.
Received a phone call from someone claiming to be Microsoft support saying my computer had a virus. They asked me to install remote access software.
